operations.label: Brightness
operations.description: Overall brightness of the whole graphic (a slider from -100 to +100).

operations.label: Contrast
operations.description: Overall contrast of the whole graphic (a slider from -100 to +100).

operations.label: Exposure
operations.description: Exposure of the whole graphic, like a camera's exposure (a slider from -100 to +100).

operations.label: Temperature
operations.description: Warmth of the whole graphic: pushes all of it towards warm, golden tones (a slider; only the warm side has an effect).

operations.label: Tint
operations.description: Shifts the hue of every colour in the whole graphic at once (a slider from -100 to +100). Not recolouring one element.

operations.label: Opacity
operations.description: How opaque the whole graphic is on the canvas, from 0% (invisible) to 100% (solid).

operations.label: Corner radius
operations.description: How rounded the corners of the graphic's frame are.

operations.label: Border width
operations.description: Thickness of the border drawn around the outside edge of the graphic.

operations.label: Border colour
operations.description: Colour of the border drawn around the outside edge of the graphic. Adding a plain border or outline around the whole graphic is this control.

operations.label: Rotation
operations.description: Rotates the WHOLE graphic on the canvas by a number of degrees. Not rotating one object inside the design.

operations.label: Flip
operations.description: Mirrors the WHOLE graphic horizontally or vertically. Not flipping one object inside the design.

operations.label: Width
operations.description: Width of the graphic on the canvas, in pixels. Not resizing the design for another platform or aspect ratio.

operations.label: Height
operations.description: Height of the graphic on the canvas, in pixels. Not resizing the design for another platform or aspect ratio.

operations.label: Position
operations.description: Where the whole graphic sits on the canvas (X and Y in pixels). Not moving an object inside the design.

operations.label: Crop
operations.description: Trims the edges of the whole graphic, cutting part of it away. Not resizing or extending the design for another platform.

operations.label: Shrink size
operations.description: Shrinks the whole graphic down to a smaller size, while keeping the same aspect ratio. Not resizing the design for another platform or aspect ratio.
